run_grpc_server: run the gRPC helloworld Greeter server on a specified port with an optional hostname
run_greeter_with_hostname: run the Greeter servicer that responds to SayHello requests with the server hostname
serve_with_health_check: serve a gRPC server with Greeter, health check, and reflection services enabled
review_Greeter_SayHello: review the Greeter class SayHello method that returns a HelloReply with the request name and hostname
review_serve_function: review the serve function that starts a gRPC server with health and reflection services
